title: Vintage Cousances by Le Creuset Cast Iron Cocotte No. 23 – Made in France – 1980s
description:
A beautiful vintage Cousances by Le Creuset cast iron cocotte, made in France and dating from the 1980s. Featuring a timeless white enamel finish with contrasting black handles and knob, this piece perfectly reflects the elegant and functional design for which French cast iron cookware is renowned.
The cocotte is in very good vintage condition, with a clean and glossy interior and a well-preserved exterior enamel. The lid is marked Cousances, while the base bears the Cousances Made in France No. 23 stamp. A wonderful piece for collectors of vintage French cookware as well as anyone who appreciates authentic cast iron craftsmanship.
This classic cocotte combines quality, durability, and understated elegance, making it a charming addition to any kitchen or collection.
As with all my vintage items, signs of age and use may be present. Please examine the photos carefully, as they form an important part of the description.
✨ A sought-after Cousances by Le Creuset piece, increasingly difficult to find in such attractive condition.
